<issue>
Enum field deserialization broken for by_value mode

#### Description

The Enum field deserialization is not working correctly when `by_value=True` or when using a field for `by_value`. The logic for handling enum lookups by value vs by name appears to be swapped.

#### Steps/Code to Reproduce

```python
from marshmallow import fields
from enum import Enum

class GenderEnum(Enum):
    male = 1
    female = 2
    non_binary = 3

# This should work but raises ValidationError
field = fields.Enum(GenderEnum, by_value=True)
result = field.deserialize(1)  # Should return GenderEnum.male

# This should also work but raises ValidationError  
field = fields.Enum(GenderEnum, by_value=fields.Integer())
result = field.deserialize(1)  # Should return GenderEnum.male

# This should work but returns ValidationError instead of the enum value
field = fields.Enum(GenderEnum)
result = field.deserialize('male')  # Should return GenderEnum.male
```

The deserialization fails when it should succeed, and in some cases returns a ValidationError object instead of raising it properly.
</issue>
